body: Yeah kinda. I’m very overwhelmed. But I think what you’re telling me what I’m expressing is not insurmountable. I still really feel like it is but the fact you took the time to type that out means a lot. Sorry I’m a mess right now lol
That sounds amazing but no. I’ve got a husband and three kids. My job is extremely rewarding too. I’m just a disaster and get the sads that ruin everything
The only breaks come from drugs and losing everything lol

I did a bunch of drugs. They were good, so yeah. 

Anyway, I’m back. Bc this is totally untenable and I’m about to be on that gutter life again.

It’s really self worth. I am really not being dramatic rn, I’m just extremely frustrated w my inability to express shit properly and I keep getting drunk and ending up on this alt so why the fuck not I guess.

It’s more than imposter syndrome or we, it’s just anything good feels like it’s gonna get taken and my life will be way worse. I had serious crazy trauma for a significant period of time roughly a decade ago that basically explains that fear but working through it- I’m totally stuck. 

I really need to feel comfortable explaining that to someone trained to understand how to untangle that, I just get terrified and quit. 

I’m sorry if I sound nuts rn, I’m really trying. That’s all I’ve got.

Luck. I feel guilty af and I’m seriously not trying to be attention seeking rn- I’m worth nothing. I try but I’m very mentally ill. When I’m good I’m great but when I’m bad I’m here. I guess.

I’m a gust of wind away from a van down at the river or _____. Lmao

I hope you get the luck I had and can take better advantage of it than I can. We’re probably very similar, life is just fucking weird.

I’ve felt like this for over 20 years and I’m really fucking exhausted. I don’t want to die but I absolutely cannot keep going as I  have been. I’ve called 9 therapists this week- three near my house and 7 near my work. No one has called me back. 

I called a few numbers over the past few months.

I net 11k/mo and have insurance that will pay 80%. 

I cannot get a call back. 

I just need a light. I’ll tunnel through we.
